results.pair_summary: Both documents define an event-driven WAL-to-Graph IR with causal/temporal edges and fault isolation mechanisms. Doc A provides a high-level architectural view including control logic, LLM state management (KV cache), and UUID-based identity with a global clock. Doc B specifies a concrete 'causal kernel' implementation featuring staging buffers, world-line branching (wld), integer IDs, and transactional commit/discard operations.
results.integration_rationale: Doc B introduces critical Delta3 Kernel features (staging, world-line isolation) missing in Doc A's simpler global-clock model. To ensure architectural consistency and kernel efficiency, Doc A should be updated to adopt Doc B's IR mechanics (Int IDs, staging, wld), while preserving Doc A's higher-level Control_Decide and Handle_Abort logic adapted to the new kernel primitives.
